statement: You are given a binary tree. The tree is given as the array tree in level order, indexed from 0: the root is tree[0], and the left and right children of the node at index i are at indices 2i + 1 and 2i + 2. null marks a position with no node, and every position below a null must be null too.

Return its preorder traversal (each node, then its left subtree, then its right subtree) without using recursion. Use an explicit stack instead: pop a node, record it, then push its right child before its left child so that the left side is handled first.

examples.explanation: 8 has children 3 and 10; 3 has children 1 and 6; 10 has only a right child, 14. The whole left subtree of 8 is finished before 10 is popped.
Each node has only a right child (2 is at index 2, 3 at index 6), so the stack never holds more than one node and the values come out top to bottom.
